decisions.reason: The position requires new concrete pavers and specifies separate bedding and joint-fill layers.

items.material_name: Gray interlocking concrete pavers, 200 × 100 × 100 mm, EN 1338 class D I or K D I
items.description: Chamfered pavers with an untreated quartz-aggregate face, UV-resistant pigments, spacers, and matching edge and end units.

items.material_name: Crushed basalt or diabase bedding aggregate, 2/5 mm
items.description: Natural crushed stone for the unbound bedding layer, specified at 3–4 cm in the detailed requirements.

items.material_name: High-grade crushed stone for lower paving joint fill, 1/3 mm
items.description: Lower joint-fill layer, ending 3 cm below the paver surface after vibration.

items.material_name: Gray crushed granite sand for upper paving joint fill, 0/3 mm
items.description: Upper joint-fill layer, washed into the joints flush with the paver surface.

decisions.reason: The pavers are reused from on-site stock, but the specified bedding and joint-fill layers require aggregate.

items.material_name: Crushed basalt or diabase bedding aggregate, 2/5 mm
items.description: Natural crushed stone for the 4 ± 1 cm unbound bedding layer beneath reused pavers.

items.material_name: High-grade crushed stone for lower paving joint fill, 1/3 mm
items.description: Lower joint-fill layer, ending 3 cm below the paver surface after vibration.

items.material_name: Gray crushed granite sand for upper paving joint fill, 0/3 mm
items.description: Upper joint-fill layer, washed into the joints flush with the paver surface.

decisions.reason: The position requires a specified mixture for a new gravel lawn base layer.

items.material_name: FLL gravel lawn base mix, 20 cm layer, EV2 45–60 MPa
items.description: Load-bearing vegetated base mix for fire and rescue vehicle standing and maneuvering areas.

decisions.reason: The sowing position requires a specified landscape grass and herb seed mixture at a stated application rate.

items.material_name: RSM 7.1.2 standard landscape grass and herb seed mix, 5 g/m²
items.description: Standard landscape lawn seed mixture with herbs and grass varieties in the highest RSM/FLL suitability class.

decisions.reason: The sowing position requires a specified parking-area grass seed mixture at a stated application rate.

items.material_name: RSM 5.1 parking-area grass seed mix, unrestricted variant 1, 25 g/m²
items.description: Parking-area lawn seed mixture using grass varieties in the highest RSM/FLL suitability class.

decisions.reason: The position prices skilled construction labor by the hour; no new product is supplied.
The ordered quantity is construction labor hours; no new product is specified.
The position covers temporary setup and removal of a dewatering pump and its connections, not purchase of the equipment.
The position pays by the day to keep the previously specified pump available and operate it.
The position requires construction of a pump sump from concrete well rings with an included gravel filter, even though the sump is later removed.

items.material_name: Concrete well-ring pump sump, DN 1000, up to 1 m deep
items.description: Temporary excavation dewatering sump with a 1000 mm clear diameter and an included gravel filter.

decisions.reason: Dynamic plate load testing is a service; the calibrated instrument is provided for use, not purchased.
Dynamic probing is an in-situ geotechnical testing service; the probing equipment is not purchased.
The position covers excavation, stockpiling, reuse, and compaction of existing soil, with no imported material specified.
The position covers trench excavation and reuse of excavated soil, with no new backfill material specified.
